verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published benchmarks or measured performance numbers from mise. The only speed-related item is an anecdotal community remark that mise is "much snappier" than asdf, which is not a measured number. This is an applicable axis for a tool/version manager, so the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see published benchmarks or measured numbers backing the manager's speed claims
